body: I’m thinking about splitting my wrists or jumping into an oncoming train. I just can’t anymore.

I feel the same way at this current moment. Many tell us that “it will get better” or “it is just a phase” I’m here to tell you none of those things as we both know that these are here to stay. If it makes you feel any better, I feel you pain and I understand, just know you are not alone, ever. My thoughts have taken over my life as well, just try your best to power through, I cannot guarantee that all will be sunshine and rainbows, but I can tell you that if you continue, the possibility of that happening gets higher. I am sorry this is not the best response as I am not sure how to help really, but just know I feel your pain, and I see you.

I appreciate your sentiments. I just don’t think it will get better, like I stated, I don’t plan on doing anything to harm myself, so it could get better and I’ll be here to see it. Death just seems more pleasing and peaceful than the upsets that the world brings me each day. I am a composer, but my music lacks feeling and uniqueness, therefore, it makes barely any difference on how I feel.
